page.notes: The left edge of the column is clipped, so the first letters of several lines are partly cut off (for example "ligunt", "nim", "ariter", "ifurpari", "rifcæ", "ft quæ", "ivata"). I have read them from the context and the full words are as printed. The Hebrew "ימין שקר" and the Greek "ἀνθρωποπαθῶς" are read from a small scan and are uncertain; the vowel marks and accents are not clear. The word "sacrosanctis" is inferred from the clipped fragment "icrofanctis". The word "ut" before "ne tolerent" is blurred and may be read differently. The line "Vna fere est quae" is partly cut off at its beginning. The printed "Pf." and "devata" are copied as printed, with "devata" as the likely reading of a blurred word.
